pattern.description: Content pattern: a regular expression by default, or exact text with literal=true. Use glob to filter files, not content.

path.description: Absolute directory or file path on the selected Environment. There is no implicit default. Directory results use paths relative to this directory; single-file results use an absolute path.

glob.description: Optional file filter for directory searches, relative to path. '*.ts' matches at any depth; 'src/*.ts' starts at path; '**/src/*.ts' includes nested src directories. A leading './' is ignored; './' alone is invalid. Cannot re-include ignored files.

ignore_case.description: Match file contents case-insensitively, without changing glob matching. Defaults to false.

literal.description: Treat the content pattern as exact text instead of as a regular expression. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of content matches to return (1 to 100000). Defaults to 100 when omitted or 0.

timeout_seconds.description: Positive search timeout in seconds. Defaults to 15.
